properties.sfomuseum:description: Handwritten letter from Harold M. Bixby to his wife, Debby Bixby, dated Sunday, March 19, [1933]; includes description of the Stinson airplane coming in from Peiping [Peking, now Beijing] and the condition of Christy Matheson [Mathewson], Jr.; description of Max Polin.
